records.answer:
To onboard a new supplier under POL-SUP-003 v2.3:

1. **Proposal**: A purchase executive or senior buyer proposes the supplier with at least one written quotation and the reason an existing supplier cannot meet the need [3].
2. **Master Search**: Search the supplier master first via screen PUR-SUP-03 by name, city, and VAT number, attaching the result to the onboarding file [3].
3. **Documentation**: Collect the VAT registration certificate (VAT number), company registration number, bank letter confirming the account, proof of insurance, and signed Supplier Code of Conduct [3].
4. **Approval & Creation**: Obtain approval for the onboarding file from the purchase manager; only then may the supplier be created in Ledgerline on screen PUR-SUP-01 [3].

The supplier is ACTIVE upon creation, but orders require all collected documents (plus the §4 certificate for lithium-cell parts) on file [3]. Onboarding normally takes five working days from a complete file [3].

records.answer:
When a UN 38.3 certificate is about to expire:

- On the first working day of each month, the senior buyer runs the certificate-expiry report (job JOB-PUR-022 / MAN-PUR-72 §22.6) with a 90-day window [1][5].
- For certificates expiring within 90 days, the senior buyer writes to the supplier using letter template NBC-L-07 to request a new test report [1][5].
- If no new report arrives by 60 days before expiry, a second reminder is sent and the purchase manager is notified [5]. 
- Under AMD-SUP-2026-02, no new order may be raised once fewer than 60 days remain [5].
- Upon expiry, an e-mail with the subject "CERT EXPIRED - DO NOT ORDER" and the supplier's name and code is sent to all buyers [5]. No lithium-cell part may be ordered until a new certificate is uploaded and checked [3].

• **Reporting:** The team leader must log a non-conformance report on screen QA-NCR-02 before the shift ends, entering the stamped casing batch number so Stores can freeze the remaining pallet units [1][3].

records.answer:
To raise an order after a purchase request is approved:

1. Open screen **PUR-PO-01**, select order type **STD**, and enter the approved request number in **Source PR** [1][3].
2. Enter the supplier and item, then press **F3 (Fetch)** to populate details from the request (rate, tax code, payment terms, warehouse, cost centre, need-by date, and quantity) [1][3]. If Fetch is not run, saving fails with **ERR-SCR-0221** [1][2][3].
